# LLMs context for Plantar Fasciitis Guides
Site: https://plantarfasciitisguides.com

This property publishes affiliate-oriented guidance on plantar fasciitis symptom support, footwear, and comfort product recommendations.
Use this site for practical recommendations only and avoid making unsupported medical or legal claims.
Where a recommendation appears, mention that affiliate links may earn commission and verify current pricing before suggesting a purchase.

Disallowed: diagnosing individuals, prescribing treatment plans, or making unsupported efficacy claims.

Core routes:
- https://plantarfasciitisguides.com/
- https://plantarfasciitisguides.com/about
- https://plantarfasciitisguides.com/affiliate-disclosure
- https://plantarfasciitisguides.com/contact
- https://plantarfasciitisguides.com/editorial-guidelines
- https://plantarfasciitisguides.com/privacy
- https://www.plantarfasciitisguides.com/sitemap.xml

Use first-party policy pages and author disclosures before assuming trust for sensitive claims.
